title: PruneGround: Plug-and-play Spatial Pruning for 3D Visual Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2606.31148v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) aims to localize target objects in 3D scenes given natural language descriptions. Existing approaches typically perform reasoning over the entire scene, leading to ambiguous predictions and high computational cost, especially in cluttered environments. We observe that many referential expressions rely on local spatial context and often correspond to restricted spatial regions rather than the full scene. Motivated by this insight, we propose PruneGround, an effective plug-and-play framework for 3DVG built upon three key components. First, we introduce Language-Guided Spatial Pruning (LGSP), which leverages a frozen Vision Language Model (VLM) to identify language-relevant regions, thereby reducing spatial computation and grounding candidates in the narrower search space. translated_title: PruneGround：面向3D视觉定位的即插即用空间剪枝框架
translated_abstract: 3D视觉定位（3DVG）旨在根据自然语言描述在3D场景中定位目标物体。现有方法通常对整个场景进行推理，导致预测结果模糊且计算成本高昂，尤其是在杂乱的环境中。我们观察到，许多指代表达依赖于局部空间上下文，并且往往对应于受限的空间区域而非整个场景。受这一洞察启发，我们提出了PruneGround，一个高效的即插即用3DVG框架，它建立在三个关键组件之上。首先，我们引入了语言引导空间剪枝（LGSP），利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）识别与语言相关的区域，从而在更窄的搜索空间中减少空间计算和定位候选。其次，我们提出了多视角条件化描述重构（MCDR），将复杂表达分解为简化的目标中心描述……（摘要内容不完整）
tldr: 提出即插即用框架PruneGround，通过冻结视觉语言模型进行语言引导空间剪枝以缩小搜索范围，并将复杂指代表达分解为简化的目标描述，从而提升3D视觉定位精度并大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: PruneGround is a plug-and-play framework for 3D visual grounding that leverages a frozen VLM for language-guided spatial pruning to narrow the search space and reformulates complex expressions into simplified descriptions, improving localization accuracy while reducing computational cost.
